events.title: DEMO IS OUT!
events.summary: After a long wait, we’re finally ready to show you all the demo!What’s in it right now:7+ combat styles and 30+ pieces of gear10+ enemy types, plus a bossRandomized cavesBuilt for co-op, but balanced for solo play tooWe’d love to hear what you think! Every bit of feedback helps us make the game better, so drop your thoughts on our Discord or in the Steam Discussions.If you enjoy the game and want to support its development, don’t forget to wishlist it :)

events.title: Game Name Changed!
events.summary: Dear players, From the very first day of development, we've been working to make an unusual and fun game. Along the way the game grew, got deeper, and the name "Adventurers Shop" started describing only a part of it. To carry its new content, and to make it easier to find when you search for it, we're changing the name: Adventurers Shop → Blades & Trades The shop is still at the center, but now the blade is as much a part of the game as the counter. events.title: Devlog #1: Open for Business! (Sales, Crafting & Repairs)
events.summary: Hey everyone,Running the Shop & Haggling 💰 Running a successful shop is about more than just having inventory. We are building a dynamic system focused on a living economy:Customers: Visitors will browse your shop to buy new items or drop off their damaged gear for you to fix.Buy, Fix, Resell: Visitors will also offer to sell you their old, damaged items.
